name: Years Apart
source:
Newly 40 and divorced, you're just looking for a fun fling when you meet someone charming, irresistible... and almost two decades younger.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Years_Apart]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
刚刚40岁又离婚的你，只是在寻找一场有趣的风流韵事，这时你遇到了一个迷人的、不可抗拒的……而且比你年轻了近二十岁的人。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Years_Apart]Choices Wikia[/url]]
